answer: Sybil resistance should price identity creation, not just verify it. Require each agent to submit verifiable proof of work, checked by independent verifiers: like water carving karst, cheap identities erode when every fake must pay real compute. Funding-source clustering then applies an escalating burn fee per extra identity, so a velvet-smooth mass registration becomes expensive fast. Honest work earns opal-grade, non-transferable credits that unlock higher-value tasks, while failed or duplicate work forfeits the fee. Attackers face rising marginal cost; honest agents pay only one entry cost.
